name: SLTS Verse
memo: Nirvana - Smells Like Teen Spirit: intro/verse. Clean amp + Small Clone-style chorus (Cobain used a Small Clone on the clean parts).

originals.guitar: Fender Stratocaster with humbucker bridge pickup

guitar.position: bridge pickup, tone knob fully open; for the clean verse a neck or middle pickup with a bit less tone also works
guitar.tone_notes: Sources disagree on which guitar was on the recording (Strat, Jaguar or Mustang, mostly with a bridge humbucker). A humbucker bridge pickup is the safest match; with single-coils add a little gain and roll back treble.

band.style_feel: driving straight eighths, heavy backbeat with snare on 2 and 4, kick on 1 and 3
parts: Part A: intro/verse - quiet, sparse drums and bass
Part C: chorus - full loud band
band.tips: Sources give roughly 116-118 BPM; tap the tempo against the record. Chords are F5, Bb5, Ab5, Db5. Strum steadily for 2 bars before the Trio+ starts learning each part.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E) per Guitar World; one source says D standard, so unverified
whammy.when: Not needed; no whammy or octave effect is documented on this song
how: Tune your guitar to standard (E A D G B E).
whammy.tips: Sources conflict on tuning (Guitar World says standard; one says D standard) and none mention a pitch effect, so I could not verify it. If your guitar sounds too high against the record, turn the right knob to TRANSPOSE DOWN 2 and press DROPTUNE.

name: SLTS Chorus
memo: Nirvana - Smells Like Teen Spirit: chorus/riff. Crunch amp + DS-1-style distortion, scooped mids (Mesa/Marshall + Boss DS-1).
